agents do not touch content/manifest.js, content/manifest.json or
server/lib/rules.php; the integrator applies this and deletes the file.
APPLY LAST. al12 is the TWELFTH and FINAL region of the aeneis track and
must follow al1..al11 in the manifest's regions array — js/app.js
regionIndex() reads that order and feeds it to the phase engine as the ONE
difficulty input (DESIGN §6). This is the hardest region in the product and
its tuning assumes index 11; inserting it earlier would under-tune it.
al12 is a PROBĀTIŌ liber (kind: 'probatio', boss id b_al12) with THREE
SENTENTIA PHASES: 4/55s + 4/50s + 4/45s. Legacy single-phase tuning in the
content file is hp 12 / 150 s. bossMinMs 15000 matches every other region.
THREE PHASES IS NOT A NEW ENGINE FEATURE AND NEEDS NO CODE. js/boss.js
buildPlan() loops `config.phases` for its whole length and filters only
unregistered types; js/boss.js ROMAN covers ten. Verified against the
source. The phases render as 'I — SENTENTIA', 'II — SENTENTIA',
'III — SENTENTIA'.
THE PER-PHASE `titulus` FIELDS ARE DOCUMENTATION, NOT UI, and must not be
'fixed'. js/boss.js phaseTitle() reads the titulus off the phase IMPL in
the registry, not off the config; only js/probatio.js's `ordina` phase
reads cfg.data.titulus (as its banner). content/historia-l6.js already
ships an inert transitus titulus on the same understanding.
All three phases declare their own `items` (6 each, 18 total, hand-authored
per AUTHORING-BRIEF 'Boss clamor/sententia items'), so js/probatio.js never
reaches its derivation fallback. Six items against hp 4 per phase is
deliberate slack: this is the track finale and it is tuned generous on
margin and climactic on clock. Nothing here for rules.php to know.
quizKey carries the same three keys per row as every other aeneis region:
rules.php stores {q, a}, and `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz
order in content/aeneis-al12.js. Region id 'al12', not 'l12' — rules.php
keys regions in one flat namespace (see a-l1.reg.json). NOTE: 'al12' must
not be matched by any prefix rule written for 'al1'; check that pair
explicitly if rules.php does prefix matching anywhere.
al12 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
XP mirrors every other aeneis region exactly. If the product wants a
track-completion award, THIS is the region to hang it on — but that is a
product decision and no such field is invented here.
